title: Manufacturing Accounts
author: 645ed7a98664cb37fb18ff9b
chapter_outcomes: Explain advantages and disadvantages of sole traders, partnerships and limited companies.
Understand key accounting terms: limited liability, equity, capital structure, share capital, loan capital.

Prepare: Income statements, Statements of financial position, Appropriation accounts, Statements of changes in equity, Manufacturing accounts, Receipts & payments accounts, Income & expenditure accounts, Statements of affairs
Classify and understand assets, liabilities, capital and accumulated fund.
Calculate and record profit distribution in partnerships (interest, salaries, drawings).
Distinguish between capital and current accounts.
Distinguish between direct/indirect costs and calculate cost of production.
Adjust financial statements for: Depreciation, Accruals and prepayments, Irrecoverable and doubtful debts, Goods taken for own use, Work in progress
Prepare accounts from incomplete records and calculate missing figures using mark-up, margin and inventory turnover.
